info.description:
The API the KyPanel screens use, open to scripts and billing systems with API tokens (`Authorization: Bearer kpt_…`). Admin tokens are created in Ky Admin › Security Center › API Tokens, account tokens in the customer panel. Browser sessions use cookies plus the `X-CSRF-Token` header on every request that isn't GET.

Errors are `application/problem+json` (see the Problem schema). Long operations answer 202 with a `job_id`: poll `GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}`, or subscribe to the `job.completed` webhook.

Every operation lists who may call it in `x-kypanel-access`: `root` (server administrator), `reseller` with the ACL keys it needs, `customer` (the account's own session or token) and whether API tokens may use it (`x-kypanel-token`).
